SLIPPERY_STICKY_SUBSTANCE.title: Slippery Sticky Substance
SLIPPERY_STICKY_SUBSTANCE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{SlipperyPower}[/blue] [gold]Slippery[/gold].
SLIPPERY_STICKY_SUBSTANCE.flavor: This sticky substance seems to form a protective film.
BROKEN_RITUAL_HORN.title: Broken Ritual Horn
BROKEN_RITUAL_HORN.description: The first time your HP falls to [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] or less each combat, [gold]Stun[/gold] all enemies for 1 turn.
BROKEN_RITUAL_HORN.flavor: Its final call leaves an entire battlefield silent.
KIN_WAR_DRUM.title: Kin War Drum
KIN_WAR_DRUM.description: If you played no [gold]Attacks[/gold] last turn, the first Attack you play this turn is played twice. Does not activate on the first turn of combat.
KIN_WAR_DRUM.flavor: One beat to gather. A second to strike.
SLEEPING_CARAPACE.title: Sleeping Carapace
SLEEPING_CARAPACE.flavor: It dreams in silence, and wakes to find the world diminished.
OVERPRESSURE_CORE.title: Overpressure Core
OVERPRESSURE_CORE.description: Whenever you manually play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Pressure[/gold]. At [blue]{PressureThreshold}[/blue] Pressure, lose all Pressure and deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
OVERPRESSURE_CORE.flavor: The stone holds. The water does not.
GHOSTLY_SWIM_BLADDER.title: Ghostly Swim Bladder
GHOSTLY_SWIM_BLADDER.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] temporary [gold]Beckon[/gold] cards into your draw pile. Every [blue]4[/blue] turns, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
GHOSTLY_SWIM_BLADDER.flavor: It still calls through waters that no longer exist.
INSATIABLE_STOMACH.title: Insatiable Stomach
INSATIABLE_STOMACH.description: Gain [blue]{Energy}[/blue] Energy each turn. At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] temporary [gold]Frantic Escape[/gold] cards into your draw pile.
INSATIABLE_STOMACH.flavor: Even severed from its host, it is never full.
FORBIDDEN_TOME.title: Forbidden Tome
FORBIDDEN_TOME.description: At the start of each combat, choose 1 of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Rare character cards to add to your hand. It costs 0 this turn and [gold]Exhausts[/gold]. At the end of your first turn, take [red]{PenaltyDamage}[/red] damage.
FORBIDDEN_TOME.flavor: The last page always demands payment.
KAISER_TWIN_CLAWS.title: Kaiser Twin Claws
KAISER_TWIN_CLAWS.description: Each turn, the first card that damages an enemy deals [blue]150%[/blue] of its normal damage. All other card damage deals [red]80%[/red] of its normal damage. These multipliers are calculated independently.
KAISER_TWIN_CLAWS.flavor: One claw crushes. The other makes every later strike feel small.
